messages:
olivia: PR #19832 (fix: vqueue backpressure) is ready to merge. CI is stuck on mac-e2e and linux-integration, queue length 12. Would prefer to land before the weekend maintenance (Fri 22:00 UTC). Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/pr/19832 :link:
mateo: I see queue high. Can you paste the failing log? Was flaky test fixed in latest commit?
olivia: failing test is `tests/e2e/replica_shutdown_test.py::test_graceful_shutdown` — flaky on mac. I pushed a tiny timeout bump (commit abc123).
ci-bot: github actions queue position: 12. Estimated start: ~45m. Last mac-e2e run for this PR failed on 1749998700 (timeout).
tess: @olivia I can give review lgtm once green. Heads up: we can't merge during Friday maintenance window (deploy freeze), ops asked to avoid merges 1h before.
sai: maintenance window is Fri 22:00-23:00 UTC. If CI doesn't start before 21:00 UTC, we should hold.
maya: option: run a targeted mac-e2e rerun now — use `./scripts/ci-rerun --pr 19832 --job mac-e2e` — that might clear the queue faster.
olivia: re-run kicked: `/github actions rerun mac-e2e` — pinging ops if we need an exception.
ops-bot: deploy-freeze starts Fri 22:00 UTC. Exceptions must be approved by @sre oncall.
mateo: if rerun fails, propose we rebase onto main and schedule Monday morning canary (08:00 UTC) — lower traffic window.
olivia: rerun started. CI status: mac-e2e queued. ETA ~30m.
tess: adding :eyes: for review. If green, I'll approve and we can land in Monday canary as fallback.
olivia: OK will hold to Monday canary if flaky persists. Thanks all.
